load_scenario_from_json: load a scenario from a JSON file path with optional apps to skip or keep
load_template_apps_and_time: load template apps and start time from a universe path JSON file
load_scenarios_from_directory: load multiple scenarios from a directory using a file filter and optional tags
load_scenarios_from_huggingface: load scenarios from a HuggingFace dataset with lazy loading for memory efficiency
load_universe: load a universe scenario from a path and tag it with CapabilityTag.Universe
